title: Use GUI foreground colour to colour in the foreground
body:
[The documentation](https://ase-lib.org/ase/gui/basics.html#high-contrast-settings) lists the options to define custom background and foreground colours in the GUI. However, the code doesn't actually use the foreground colour for anything after it's saved to gui.window.fg

This MR makes atoms, lines, and text on the canvas take the colour set _via_ gui_foreground_color
